author: Remmelink, Willem (ed. and tr.)
title: The Invasion of the South: Army Air Force Operations, and the Invasion of Northern and Central Sumatra
edition: English translation of extracts from Senshi Sōsho vols 34 and 5; third of the Corts Foundation trilogy, after The Invasion of the Dutch East Indies (2015) and The Operations of the Navy in the Dutch East Indies and the Bay of Bengal (2018)
notes: Filed as official-history because that is its form — it is the Senshi Sōsho, in English — rather than for the use these packs will make of it, which is slight: it covers the southern advance of 1941–42 and Sumatra, at the edge of this arc. It is in the registry for what it demonstrates. It is the only volume of Japan's official history that a reader of this project can open, read and cite in English without a library, being published open access; and one open volume out of 102 is the honest measure of the problem stated in source:senshi-sosho. The publisher's page above is reachable from here; the OAPEN copy of the PDF, which the publisher points to, refuses this repository's requests, so no direct link to the file is given.
